defectFoundAndFixed.before: the port on MySQL 8.4.11 answered nothing: ERROR 'Illegal argument to a regular expression.' (ER_REGEXP_ILLEGAL_ARGUMENT); the original (MariaDB 11.4.5, PCRE) answered ["Matchprobe Dots"]
defectFoundAndFixed.mechanism: the port binds the raw pattern to the server's REGEXP unchanged; MySQL 8's ICU does not implement the MySQL 5.7 word-boundary forms [[:<:]] / [[:>:]] and refuses them, so the search errors and no count is produced
defectFoundAndFixed.fix: the two word-boundary forms are translated into the \b every MySQL-class server accepts before the pattern is bound (translateServerRegexp in src/cql/normalize.ts, applied in the ~~ branch of src/cql/sql.ts); the translation is exact, and every other construct (POSIX classes, \p{...}) still reaches the server as written
defectFoundAndFixed.after: the same query answers ["Matchprobe Dots"], count 1 - the original's recorded answer
defectFoundAndFixed.pin: the suite's own leg measures the server's refusal and the translated form's answer; the SQL generation pins hold the translation and the untouched constructs (tests/cql/sql-generation.test.ts)
